name: Grinchfest
venue: Golf Course Road Church of Christ
address: 3500 W Golf Course Rd, Midland, TX 79703
cost: Price not listed; the holiday activity stations are described as free
paras: Whiskers & Tails Animal Rescue hosts Grinchfest on Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 11 am to 3 pm at Golf Course Road Church of Christ in west Midland. Families meet the Grinch, pose for photos and pick up a Grinchfest Passport.
Kids collect stamps at free holiday activity stations scattered through the event. Money raised supports the rescue's pet care and low-cost spay and neuter services.
tip: Pick up the passport right after the Grinch photo so the kids can stamp every station.

name: Storytime: Pig the Elf at the Fredda Turner Durham Children's Museum
paras: The Fredda Turner Durham Children's Museum reads Aaron Blabey's Christmas picture book Pig the Elf on Saturday, December 26, 2026, from 11 to 11:30 am. The story follows a greedy pug who ends up on Santa's sleigh.
The reading happens in the museum's calming room, and the museum says no registration is required.
tip: The calming room keeps the reading quiet, which suits kids who like a gentler Saturday outing.
